scope: source eligibility/selection coverage, no cross-cell clone assignment or concentration
amendment: v2 completes previously blank receptor-only mouse mapping through source join v3; CD8 eligibility values unchanged
flags_overlap: Flags overlap; source_chain_category is a mutually exclusive ordered disposition. No-productivity means no source-annotated productive slot, not absence of a biological receptor.
complete_productive_slot_rule: functionality exactly productive; nonempty ACGT nucleotide junction; nonempty matching TRA/TRB V and J call tokens. Pipe-delimited source ambiguity retained as sorted call sets, not resolved.
eligibility: Single: exactly one productive alpha and beta slot, complete. Set: >=1 complete productive slot of each lineage. Both exclude any incomplete productive slot or nonstandard functionality; explicit nonproductive/empty/no-result secondary slots do not imply known biological absence.
duplicates: Within-cell duplicate slot records identified only as a coverage flag; no cross-cell receptor keys or frequencies generated.
